top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Provide a written emergency evacuation plan.
Ensure receptacles at patient bed locations and where general anesthesia is administered, are tested after initial installation, replacement or servicing.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Have posted "No-smoking" signs in areas where smoking is not permitted or ashtrays provided where smoking was allowed.
Install noncombustible or limited-combustible interior walls.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Designate a qualified infection preventionist to be responsible for the infection prevent and control program in the nursing home.
Ensure each resident must receive and the facility must provide necessary behavioral health care and services.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
